description: A short check for IT service desk staff at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company, taken before the awareness episodes (pair AB). Ten items from the IT service desk queue: calls, a voicemail, emails and a sign-in prompt. The result is kept so the matching after-check (awareness_post_helpdesk_ab) can show how the two compare. Organiser note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
